articles.title: Burnham says he will review early prisoner release scheme
articles.description: The prime minister says he cannot commit to changing the policy but wants to look at it in detail "before we go further forward".

articles.title: Ukrainian drones hit more sites of Russian online retailer Wildberries
articles.description: Logistics hubs belonging to Wildberries in the Krasnodar and Stavropol regions were struck overnight.

articles.title: Some food prices have fallen – but inflation expected to rise from here
articles.description: June's fall in inflation will be welcomed by the new prime minister but analysts warn the fall is temporary.

articles.title: Southampton boss Eckert charged by FA over Spygate
articles.description: Southampton head coach Tonda Eckert is charged by the Football Association for his role in the Spygate scandal.
